US Stocks Decline on Fed Chair Warsh's Inflation Concerns

US stocks closed lower as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated the central bank's commitment to controlling inflation, signaling a potential interest rate hike in September. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all experienced declines. This development also led to concerns about potential pressure on India's Nifty index, with elevated US bond yields, a stronger dollar, and rising crude oil prices cited as factors that could impact foreign institutional investment flows into India.
